description: Performance-based scoring system. Calculates a score out of 100 each month for every active client. Score is based on 4 pillars: Rankings, Traffic, Leads, GMB. No subjective factors — purely what was delivered.

pillars.description: Based on how many target keywords are ranking in top 10 this month.

scoring.condition: 80% or more of tracked keywords in top 10
Less than 20% of tracked keywords in top 10

scoring.note: Base score for new clients — rankings take time

bonuses.condition: Any keyword reached position 1–3 this month
3 or more keywords improved position this month

pillars.description: Based on month-on-month organic traffic growth.

scoring.condition: Traffic grew 20% or more from last month
Traffic same as last month (0% change)

bonuses.condition: Organic traffic is 70% or more of total traffic

pillars.description: Based on total leads (calls + forms + WhatsApp) generated this month.

bonuses.condition: Leads grew 20% or more from last month

pillars.notes: Lead thresholds are general. For low-volume niches (IELTS, Modular Kitchen, IVF) adjust thresholds down by 50% — e.g. 10+ leads = 25 points.

pillars.description: Based on Google Business Profile activity — views, calls, and review growth.

scoring.condition: Profile views above 500 AND at least 1 new review this month
Profile views 300–499 AND at least 1 new review
Profile views 200–299 OR 1 new review (but not both)
Profile views 100–199 and no new reviews
GMB not yet set up or not connected

bonuses.condition: 2 or more new reviews this month

tiers.message: Strong performance across all pillars. Client is seeing real results.
tiers.action: Flag as upsell candidate. Mention growth in next call.

tiers.message: Solid progress. Most pillars are performing well.
tiers.action: Identify the lowest-scoring pillar and prioritise it next month.

tiers.message: Progress is slow. One or more pillars are underperforming.
tiers.action: Review what's blocking growth. Jabeer to do a quick check-in call with client.

tiers.message: Performance is below expectation. Immediate action required.
tiers.action: Jabeer to personally call the client. Review service delivery and identify root cause.

scoreNote.newClient: New clients (month 1 and 2) start with base scores across all pillars. Rankings and traffic take 60–90 days to build — scores will naturally increase from month 3 onwards.
scoreNote.trend: A rising score over 3+ months is the most important signal, even if the absolute score is moderate.
scoreNote.upsellTrigger: Clients at Excellent tier for 2 consecutive months should be flagged for upsell conversation.

calculationRules.bonusCap: Bonuses can push a pillar above its base max by a maximum of 5 points, but total score is capped at 100.
calculationRules.rounding: Round final score to nearest whole number.
